album.title: Radif of Persian Music on Setar I

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb4 and dwells most on Gb in Chaharmezrab. The line peaks at Gb4 (382.5 Hz) at 0:48.0. It closes on the tonic (Gb4 → D4 → E4 → Gb4 → B2 → B3).

theory_fit.name: Pythagorean / Safi al-Din
theory_fit.description: Nearest note of the 17-note gamut generated by pure fifths (±8) from the tonic.

theory_fit.name: Farhat interval classes
theory_fit.description: Interval classes Hormoz Farhat measured in performance practice ("The Dastgah Concept in Persian Music", 1990). Approximate centres.

flags: tonic B set in the catalog (Shur's finalis B (126.4 Hz), which Abu-Ata keeps (Farhat 1990, p. 35): from B the suite is one Shur scale (0, 137, 295, 497, 702 cents) and the Masnavi voted it. The vote picked the 5th above (F sharp). Inference, not yet by ear); the runs' vote favoured 380.1 Hz (G)
